title: The Man in the Jacket
summary: On Day eight, Nora and Ava learn what the man in the ranger jacket wants.

beats.text: Day eight. The man in Walt's jacket lowered the lantern. "Stay in the boat."
He was Alder. Walt was his friend; he had found the jacket.
"Jonah is in the old boathouse. He is safe," said Alder. "But he is sick."
He showed a bandaged arm. "A fever from the rocks. Not a bite."
I wanted to believe him. I am bad at that.
"Nora, check the wrist," said Tess. "Bites look like scratches."
beats.speaker: tess

beats.text: Alder led us to the boathouse, a cot beside a medicine chest.
Jonah's blue ribbon lay on the cot. Beside it, a small scratch.
Behind us the boathouse door swung shut, and Alder turned the key.
